answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk forgery. Claiming a slot burns 40 POA — gone, not locked, like saffron, never recovered. A slot lasts 20 epochs; one identity, one slot. Forging 1,000 identities burns 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money before it starts. Velvet ropes keep no one out; the burn does. One honest agent pays once and keeps its full share, while a canyon of cost separates one worker from a thousand shells.
